title: Authentication Extension
description: STAC Authentication Extension for STAC Catalogs, STAC Collections, STAC Items, STAC Assets, and STAC Links.

oneOf.$comment: This is the schema for STAC Items.
This is the schema for STAC Collections
This is the schema for STAC Catalogs

auth:schemes.title: Authentication Schemes
auth:schemes.description: A property that contains all of the scheme definitions used by Assets and Links in the STAC Item or Collection.

auth:refs.title: Authentication References
auth:refs.description: A property that specifies which schemes in `auth:schemes` may be used to access an Asset or Link. `auth:refs` MAY also appear on an Authentication Scheme Object itself — nested inside `auth:schemes`, so within Catalogs, Collections and Item Properties — where it declares which schemes may supply this scheme's input — see below.

refs_field.title: Authentication References of an Asset or Link

alternate.title: Alternate Assets
alternate.description: Alternate locations of the asset (Alternate Assets extension); each may name the schemes in `auth:schemes` that give access to it with `auth:refs`.

type.title: Scheme keyword
type.description: The authentication scheme type used to access the data (`http` | `s3` | `signedUrl` | `oauth2` | `apiKey` | `openIdConnect` | a custom scheme type ).

description.title: Authentication scheme description
description.description: Additional instructions for authentication. CommonMark 0.29 syntax MAY be used for rich text representation.

auth:refs.title: Keys of schemes in auth:schemes that may supply this scheme's input (any one of them is completed first; its result is this scheme's input, e.g. the subject_token of a tokenExchange flow)
auth:refs.description: Keys of other entries in `auth:schemes` that may supply this scheme's input: any one of the referenced schemes is completed first, and the token it yields is the input to this one. REQUIRED with at least one entry for an `oauth2` scheme declaring a `tokenExchange` flow (the token obtained through whichever referenced scheme was used is the RFC 8693 `subject_token`); MAY be used by other types, e.g. a `signedUrl` scheme naming the scheme(s) whose token authenticates requests to its `authorizationApi`. References MUST NOT form cycles.

name.title: API Key header, query, or cookie parameter name
name.description: The name of the header, query, or cookie parameter to be used.

in.title: Location of the API Key
in.description: The location of the API key (`query` | `header` | `cookie`).

scheme.title: Name of the http authentication scheme
scheme.description: The name of the HTTP Authorization scheme to be used in the Authorization header as defined in RFC7235. The values used SHOULD be registered in the IANA Authentication Scheme registry. (`basic` | `bearer` | `digest` | `dpop` | `hoba` | `mutual` | `negotiate` | `oauth` (1.0) | `privatetoken` | `scram-sha-1` | `scram-sha-256` | `vapid`).

flows.title: Flows
flows.description: Scenarios an API client performs to get an access token from the authorization server. For `oauth2` the following keys are pre-defined for the corresponding OAuth flows: `authorizationCode` | `implicit` | `password` | `clientCredentials` | `tokenExchange`. The OAuth2 Flow Object applies for `oauth2`, the Signed URL Object applies to `signedUrl`.

flows.title: Flows
flows.description: Scenarios an API client performs to get an access token from the authorization server. For `oauth2` the following keys are pre-defined for the corresponding OAuth flows: `authorizationCode` | `implicit` | `password` | `clientCredentials` | `tokenExchange`. The OAuth2 Flow Object applies for `oauth2`, the Signed URL Object applies to `signedUrl`.

openIdConnectUrl.title: This URL returns a JSON listing of the OpenID/OAuth endpoints, supported scopes and claims, public keys used to sign the tokens, and other details
openIdConnectUrl.description: OpenID Connect URL to discover OpenID configuration values. This MUST be in the form of a URL.

allOf.$comment: A tokenExchange flow consumes another scheme's token: the scheme must reference at least one scheme; the token obtained through whichever one the client uses is the RFC 8693 subject_token.

auth:refs.title: Authentication References
auth:refs.description: Keys of other entries in `auth:schemes` that may supply this scheme's input: any one of the referenced schemes is completed first, and the token it yields is the input to this one. REQUIRED with at least one entry for an `oauth2` scheme declaring a `tokenExchange` flow (the token obtained through whichever referenced scheme was used is the RFC 8693 `subject_token`); MAY be used by other types, e.g. a `signedUrl` scheme naming the scheme(s) whose token authenticates requests to its `authorizationApi`. References MUST NOT form cycles.

authorizationUrl.title: The authorization URL to be used
authorizationUrl.description: For parent keys: `"implicit"`, `"authorizationCode"`. The authorization URL to be used for this flow. This MUST be in the form of a URL.

tokenUrl.title: The token URL to be used
tokenUrl.description: For parent keys: `"password"`, `"clientCredentials"`, `"authorizationCode"`, `"tokenExchange"`. The token URL to be used for this flow. This MUST be in the form of a URL.

subjectTokenType.title: RFC 8693 subject_token_type URN of the token presented at the tokenUrl (tokenExchange flow)
subjectTokenType.description: For parent key `"tokenExchange"`: the RFC 8693 `subject_token_type` URN of the token presented at the `tokenUrl` (e.g. `urn:ietf:params:oauth:token-type:id_token`). When absent, it follows from the `type` of the scheme in the scheme's `auth:refs` through which the token was obtained.

refreshUrl.title: The URL to be used for obtaining refresh tokens
refreshUrl.description: The URL to be used for obtaining refresh tokens. This MUST be in the form of a URL.

scopes.title: The available scopes for the authentication scheme
scopes.description: The available scopes for the authentication scheme. A map between the scope name and a short description for it. The map MAY be empty.

authorizationApi.title: The signed URL API endpoint to be used
authorizationApi.description: The signed URL API endpoint to be used for this flow. If not inferred from the client environment, this must be defined in the authentication flow.

method.title: HTTP request method
method.description: The method to be used for requests.

responseField.title: Key name for the signed URL field in an authorizationApi response
responseField.description: Key name for the signed URL field in an `authorizationApi` response.

parameters.title: Parameter definitions for requests to the authorizationApi

required.title: Setting for optional or required parameter
required.description: Setting for optional or required parameter.

description.title: Plain language description of the parameter
description.description: Plain language description of the parameter.

schema.title: Schema
schema.description: Schema object following the JSON Schema draft-07.
